QuickSnap uses the microphone during process recordings to capture spoken context alongside your screenshots. The audio is transcribed on-device — recordings are not sent anywhere unless you enable an LLM provider.
QuickSnap transcribes your voice during process recordings so the generated runbook, walkthrough, bug report, or QA report can include what you said. Transcription runs on-device when supported.
